# Manuscript

> Manuscript is a statically typed language for native programs, with named arguments, mutable data, explicit errors, scoped resources, and concurrent work through library APIs.

Links are relative to this file so GitHub Pages project paths and custom domains work alike.

## Read in order
- [Get started](learn/getting-started/): a complete application and CLI commands
- [Language tour](learn/tour/): functions, data, and expected failures
- [Language](core-language/): basics, functions, types, control flow, errors, modules, and resources
- [Standard library](standard-library/): imports, services, data, files, processes, and networking
- [Concurrent work](concurrency/): tasks, cancellation, scheduling, and synchronized updates
- [Developer tools](developer-tooling/): commands, projects, source tools, and debugging

## Look up a declaration
- [Entire standard library as Markdown](stdlib.md): every standard module, intrinsic prelude, generic bound, field, case, operation, and special call rule
- [Standard library JSON](stdlib.json): versioned structured declaration snapshot
- [API reference](standard-library/reference/): browsable generated declarations
- [Special call rules](standard-library/call-rules/): additional compiler checks
- [Glossary](glossary/): language terminology

## Contribute
- [Contributor documentation](contributing/): architecture, development checks, compiler internals, and releases
